source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Low-level disinfection, a standard generally considered insufficient for this category of device, similar to the lighter cleaning step the new staff member is currently assuming would be sufficient","B":"High-level disinfection, per strict reprocessing protocols, given documented outbreak risk from improper reprocessing, rather than the lighter cleaning step the new staff member is currently assuming would be enough","C":"Little to no disinfection between uses, based on the assumption that these devices carry minimal risk, similar to what the new staff member is currently assuming","D":"Mainly a visual inspection, with little chemical or mechanical disinfection step performed afterward, similar to what the new staff member is currently assuming would be sufficient"}}
source_row.rationale: Flexible endoscopes require high-level disinfection at minimum per strict reprocessing protocols, since improperly reprocessed scopes have been linked to serious infection outbreaks.
